entries.text: Tinder is the fluffy dry stuff that takes the first spark.
Kindling is a thin stick, no thicker than your thumb.
Fuel is a stick as thick as your wrist, or thicker.
A ferro rod is a metal stick that throws sparks when you scrape it.
To baton is to hit the back of a knife with a stick so the wood splits.
entries.kid_text: Hit the knife with a stick to split wood.

entries.text: An ember is a small red glow that is not a flame yet.
A coal is a hot glowing piece you can blow into a flame.
A hearth is the flat board the drill spins on.
entries.kid_text: The flat board under the stick.

entries.text: A spindle is the straight stick you spin to make heat.
Fatwood is pine wood full of sticky sap. It lights when wet.
